result:
All 14 queries ran and gave plausible answers on the input files. I did not check K2's missing-total case or K14's missing-`qty` case against the data; both queries treat a missing field as absent. Only K5 and K14 have an explicit tie-breaker in the sort.

- **K11:** qlang has no `trim`, so I split each tag on spaces and joined the pieces back. That strips all spaces, including any inside a tag, which these tags don't have.
- **K6:** I get 34.7. **K12:** I get 103.32.

K1: ["Apple","banana","APPLE","Cherry","banana","date","Date","elderberry"] * lower | distinct | count
K2: filter ~(/status | eq "paid") | groupBy ~(/customer) * (* (at :total | coalesce 0) | sum)
K3: lines * (split " " | /1) | groupBy ~(/) * count
K4: [/dependencies /devDependencies] | union | filter ~(startsWith "^") | keys * keyword | sort
K5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~([(at :comments | coalesce 0 | mul -1) /id]) | take 3 * /id
K6: lines | drop 1 * split "," | filter ~(/2 | lower | eq "de") | filter ~(/1 | ne "") * (/1 | parseJson) | :v / | (sum | div (v | count)) | mul 10 | round | div 10
K7: /services | :s / | keys | filter ~(:k / | s | at k | [(at :enabled | eq true) (at :port | type | eq ::number)] | every ~(/)) | sort ~(:k / | s | at k | /port) * (:k / | [(keyword) (s | at k | /port | print)] | join ":")
K8: /results | filter ~([(at :email | coalesce "" | split "@" | at 1 | coalesce "" | lower | eq "example.com") (at :user | coalesce {} | at :name | coalesce {} | at :last | ne null)] | every ~(/)) * [(/user/name/last) (/user/name/first)] * (join ", ")
K9: filter ~([(at :user | ne null) (at :action | coalesce "" | lower | eq "login")] | every ~(/)) * (/user | lower) | distinct | sort
K10: filter ~(at :salary | ne null) | groupBy ~(/dept) * (* /salary | :v / | sum | div (v | count) | mul 100 | round | div 100)
K11: * (at :tags | coalesce "" | split ",") | flat * (lower | split " " | join "") | filter ~(ne "") | groupBy ~(/) * count | :c / | keys | sort ~(:k / | [(c | at k | mul -1) (keyword)]) | take 3 * keyword
K12: lines | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) | filter ~(ne "") * (split "|" | [(/1 | parseJson) (/2 | parseJson)] | mul /0 /1) | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100
K13: /services | filter ~(/env | lower | eq "prod") | every ~(at :replicas | coalesce 1 | gte 2)
K14: * {:id /id :itemCount (at :items | coalesce [] * /qty | sum)} | filter ~(/itemCount | gt 0) | sort ~([(/itemCount | mul -1) /id]) | take 3
